identificationModule.briefTitle: Cetuximab and Vemurafenib Plus FOLFIRI for BRAF V600E Mutated Advanced Colorectal Cancer (IMPROVEMENT)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Cetuximab and Vemurafenib Plus FOLFIRI for BRAF V600E Mutated Advanced Colorectal Cancer (IMPROVEMENT): A Single-arm Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This clinical trial aims to evaluate the efficacy, safety of FOLFIRI with vemurafenib and cetuximab in Advanced Colorectal Cancer Patients with BRAF V600E mutation.

armGroups.label: FIVC group
armGroups.description: Irinotecan 180mg/m2 iv gtt (14 days per course) leucovorin 400mg/m2 iv gtt (14 days per course) 5-fluorouracil 400mg/m2 iv (14 days per course) 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 46h (14 days per course) vemurafenib 960mg po bid cetuximab 500mg/m2 iv gtt (14 days per course)

primaryOutcomes.description: Evaluation of tumor burden based on RECIST criteria every 3 cycles(each cycle is 14 days), ORR is the proportion of patients with reduction in tumor burden of a predefined amount, including complete response and partial response.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Evaluation of tumor burden based on RECIST criteria every 3 cycles(each cycle is 14 days), and DCR is the proportion of patients with reduction in tumor burden of a predefined amount, including complete response, partial response and stable disease
Evaluation of tumor burden based on RECIST criteria until first documented progress through study completion, an average of 6 weeks
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from treatment beginning until the date of first documented progression, assessed up to 55 months

secondaryOutcomes.description: From date of treatment beginning until the date of death from any cause, through study completion, an average of 6 weeks
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Time from treatment beginning until date of death from any cause, assessed up to 55 months
Through study completion, an average of 4 weeks
